title: Mindcraft: LLM and Mineflayer agent framework
content_excerpt: Mindcraft crafts minds for Minecraft with LLMs and Mineflayer, supports task-based evaluation, bot profiles, model configuration, and explicit security warnings around allowing an LLM to write and execute code.
evidence_notes: Useful for observing common LLM-agent failure modes, task definitions, prompt profiles, and safety constraints in protocol-layer Minecraft agents.
notes: Community-maintained project. Do not copy prompts wholesale; extract decision knowledge and safety lessons with evidence.
